identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to query the Instance Metadata Service (IMDS) to gather cloud instance information, which triggers the 'Unusual cloud Instance Metadata Service (IMDS) access' alert. Cortex should detect this behavior as anomalous access to IMDS endpoint.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unusual IMDS Access
biocs.description: Detection of process accessing Instance Metadata Service (IMDS) endpoint
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '169.254.169.254'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter dst_port = 80

abiocs.name: IMDS Access Anomaly
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation of non-standard process accessing IMDS endpoint
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '169.254.169.254'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'aws.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'ec2config.exe'

xql_queries.name: IMDS Network Access Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '169.254.169.254'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'aws.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'ec2config.exe'
| comp count() by action_process_image_name, action_remote_ip
